description: Speech Rule Engine tests with Jest

scripts.test:all: pnpm test:files; pnpm test:output; pnpm test:analytics
scripts.test:analytics: pnpm rimraf analysis; pnpm test --silent --testPathPatterns tests/analyse; pnpm test:allrules
scripts.test:allrules: export SRE_JSON_PATH=../lib/mathmaps; echo "import('./js/module_loader.js').then((m) => m.loadPromise('at')).then(m => m.default.outputAllRules())" | node
scripts.analyse:tries: export SRE_JSON_PATH=../lib/mathmaps; echo "import('./js/module_loader.js').then((m) => m.loadPromise('atrie')).then(m => m.default.output())" | node
scripts.local:api: START=$(grep -nm 1 "jest\.fn\(\)" js/classes/api_test.js | cut -d: -f1); END=$(grep -nm 1 "var Expression" js/classes/api_test.js | cut -d: -f1); END=$((END - 1)); sed -i "${START},${END}d" "js/classes/api_test.js"
scripts.build: pnpm clean; pnpm prepare && pnpm compile
scripts.clean: pnpm rimraf dist js tests coverage
